item.title: Autonomy over execution is not authority over strategy
item.description: Telling an experienced person to “figure it out” can delegate an unresolved strategic decision without delegating the authority to make it.

item.title: Experience Changes the Kind of Clarity You Need
item.description: John Cutler argues that experienced people need fewer instructions but more strategic clarity, and leaders often mistake their exercise of judgment for being high maintenance.
